title: Cuban Adjustment: what USCIS is doing
empty: There is no monthly data to show yet.
pulse.title: USCIS data for {month}
pulse.note: The "I-485 (Cuban)" row of the USCIS monthly report: the only official monthly figure for Cuban green card applications.
avg.hint: Tap the average to see why it is not a forecast.
avg.title: Why this average is not a forecast
avg.body: {avg} is how long, on average, the few cases USCIS finished in {month} took: {n} decisions among {pending} pending. It describes cases that already finished, not when a case that is still pending will be decided.
chart.title: Month by month
chart.note: Shaded bands are adjudication holds (R1 and R3). August 2024 is missing from the published files.
approval.title: When USCIS decides, how many are approvals?
approval.quarter: {quarter}: {approved} approved and {denied} denied out of {completions} decisions ({share}).
approval.caveat: The rate fell because few cases were decided during the hold and many were clear denials; it does not mean that three in four Cubans are being refused.
approval.separate: These shares describe the national group; they are not the approval chance of any one case, and they are never mixed into the timing estimate.
approval.pendingNote: Pending cases in the quarterly report run a little below the monthly report; the headline pending figure comes from the monthly report.
